newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-LIEBENBERG LOOKS TO REBUILD FREE STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LIEBENBERG LOOKS TO REBUILD FREE STATE.

text.p: Free State cricketer Gerhardus Liebenberg will become his province's third captain in as many years when he takes charge of the Bloemfontein-based side for the 1997-98 season.
Liebenberg takes over the captaincy from Louis Wilkinson who filled the void created by Hansie Cronje's frequent absences on national duty last year.
Wilkinson, who as skipper had an unhappy season plagued with injury, remains in the playing squad for 1997-98.

Having won the domestic limited-overs trophy three years in a row from 1993-94 onwards, Free State failed to reach the top six last season and are now in the process of rebuilding a relatively young side.
The province have lost the services of veteran West Indian all-rounder Franklyn Stephenson, who has decided to return to his native Barbados.
Free State coach Corrie van Zyl said on Wednesday that Stephenson would not be replaced by another overseas player.
"The cost of finding a player of Franklyn's quality would be too high and we prefer to concentrate on developing our own talent," van Zyl said at a news conference.
